## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

A user-manual page covering the `buck2.testCache` options, the `no-test-cache` label, `tk --no-test-cache`, per-user overrides, and how a consumer's own test rule opts in through the helper (spec §1, §6, §7).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The page documents every user-facing option, flag and label
- [ ] It shows a consumer test rule calling the helper
- [ ] It explains what `recorded` means and when tests run uncached

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.14
- turnkey-vnm.15
- turnkey-vnm.25
title: User manual: test result caching
